message.content:
Now I see it! The commit `ce00c36e` changed `pushTab` from `void **` to `xmlStartTag *`. Before this commit, `pushTab` was a `void **` array where each element was 4 slots wide (prefix, URI, line, nsNr). The line was stored as `(void *)(ptrdiff_t) line` - casting an integer to a void pointer.

The "bad-cast" issue is that when reading `ctxt->pushTab[ctxt->nameNr * 4 - 2]` as a `ptrdiff_t`, the value stored there was `(void *)(ptrdiff_t) line`, which is a cast of an integer to a pointer. When UBSan is enabled, this is flagged as a "bad-cast" because you're casting an integer to a pointer type.
